properties.message_511: On I-64 at mile marker 182.8 in the County of Henrico, motorists can expect delays due to a vehicle crash. The west right shoulder is closed.

On I-95 at mile marker 138.7 in the County of Stafford, motorists can expect delays due to a disabled vehicle. The north left shoulder is closed.
